name: sdlc
description: Application development: tests, lint and build are the deterministic anchor.

rubric.functionality: Each acceptance criterion behaves as written, including the edge cases it names. Score from observed behaviour (run the check), not from reading intent.
rubric.quality: Readable, consistent with the surrounding code, no dead code or duplication introduced by the change. Style preferences are not defects.
rubric.security: Input validation at trust boundaries, no secrets in code or logs, safe defaults, least privilege. Only the contract's SC criteria and regressions are blocking.
rubric.errors: Every ES scenario handled as specified; failures reported with a clear message and exit code, never swallowed; no stack traces leaked to users.
rubric.tests: Each new criterion has a test that fails without the change and passes with it. No skipped or focused tests, no weakened assertions.
